reasoning: On the season so far the Spurs are the stronger team; with home court the Spurs start about 10 points better, in a game of about 229 points.
Rest, travel and who is missing tilt it about 2 points towards the Spurs.
The mental side leans about 2 points towards the Warriors (confidence).
Bottom line: the Spurs win 81 times in 100, by about 10; most games like this end between 197 and 245 total points.

analyst.text: Golden State's eight-game win streak ended in Houston. Worse, an MRI showed Stephen Curry, who was second in the league in scoring, has an oblique abdominal tear. He will be re-evaluated in two weeks. The unresolved Kristaps Porzingis standoff adds noise on the second leg of a five-game trip. San Antonio have won ten straight, including a comeback from 22 down in Chicago. Without Curry the mental lean is clearly toward the Spurs.
